# SMRITI Support

Thank you for using SMRITI Retail OS!

Before opening a support request, please explore the following channels:

## 📖 Documentation
- **[SMRITI Wiki](https://github.com/erpnbook/smriti/wiki)**: The primary documentation portal containing installation guides, Quick Start instructions, and studio overviews.
- **[Business Dictionary](https://github.com/erpnbook/smriti/wiki/Business-Dictionary)**: Key definitions and metrics explanation.

## 💬 Community Support
- **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/erpnbook/smriti/discussions)**: Ask questions, share ideas, and showcase your deployments.

## 🐛 Bug Reports
If you have found a verified bug:
1. Search existing issues to see if it has already been reported.
2. Open a new issue using the **Bug Report** template.
